newsitem.title: USA: Lockheed names Coffman as vice chairman.
newsitem.headline: Lockheed names Coffman as vice chairman.

text.p: Lockheed Martin said Thursday it named its Dr Vance Coffman as vice chairman, effective Aug 1.
Coffman is president and chief operating officer of Lockheed Martin. Since April, he has been slated to succeed Norman Augustine as the chief executive officer on Aug 1.
Coffman will also assume the vice chairman post on Aug 1, the company said Thursday.
Augustine, who announced in April that he was retiring, will continue to serve as chairman of the board of directors, Lockheed said.
Peter Teets, currently the president of the information and services sector, will take over the president and chief operating officer roles from Coffman, a company spokesman said.
Lockheed earlier Thursday said it would acquire Northrop Grumman Corp in a deal valued at $11.6 billion.
